title: Pathfinder Regional Tech High 2027
subtitle: Pathfinder Regional Tech High Washington, D.C. April 6-9, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Pathfinder Regional Tech High. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel to Washington, D.C. & National Museum of American History

  • Travel to Washington, D.C.!
  • Visit the National Museum of American History
  • Visit the National 9/11 Pentagon Memorial
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Visit the Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam, and Korean War Memorials, World War II Memorial, and Washington Monument
  • Check-in to Hotel Accommodations with Overnight Security (three nights)
 

Day 2: Arlington National Cemetery & Smithsonian Museum of Natural History

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the US Marine Corps War Memorial: Iwo Jima
  • Landmark Leader Led Walking Tour of Arlington National Cemetery 
  • Lunch Allocation 
  • Visit the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum
  • Visit the Smithsonian Museum of Natural History 
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Visit the Thomas Jefferson, Franklin Delano Roosevelt, and MLK Memorials around the Tidal Basin
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 3: United States Capitol Building & National Archives

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Library of Congress
  • Lunch Allocation 
  • Public Guided Tour of the United States Capitol Building 
  • Visit the Supreme Court Building Exhibit 
  • Visit the National Archives 
  • White House Photo Opportunity 
  • Dinner and Games!
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 4: Smithsonian National Zoological Park & Departure

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Smithsonian National Zoological Park 
  • Boxed Sandwich Lunch 
  • Departure for Home
introHeading: Pathfinder Regional Tech High, get ready for an unforgettable Washington, D.C. adventure in 2027! 🏛️
introText: This Washington, D.C. journey immerses students in the stories, sacrifices, and triumphs that shaped the United States. From the moving memorials along the National Mall to a guided walk through Arlington National Cemetery, every experience is designed to educate and inspire. Students will visit the Supreme Court Building, explore the Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History, and snap a photo outside the White House — making this the perfect blend of history, learning, and unforgettable moments your students will never forget!
